top_stories.title: US police responding to dozens of shots fired near the White House | News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **FBI Director Kash Patel** and **President Donald Trump** were reportedly inside the White House when shots were fired near the building.  Multiple emergency vehicles cordoned off access to the White House, with police and National Guard troops blocking reporters from entering the area. The Secret Service is working to corroborate reports of gunfire near 17th Street and Pennsylvania Avenue NW. No injuries have been reported at this time.

top_stories.title: Australia news live: Queensland police shot dead man north of Brisbane; gunshots heard near White House | Australia news | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Queensland police** shot and killed an alleged domestic violence perpetrator who was armed with a firearm at a home north of Brisbane. The incident occurred after midnight on Sunday morning, following reports that the man was making threats. **Police Ethical Standards Command**, with oversight from the Crime and Corruption Commission, will investigate the shooting. Three people were transported to hospital in stable conditions, while paramedics assessed a patient in a life-threatening condition at the scene.

top_stories.title: Centre asks Delhi Gymkhana Club to hand over premises by June 5 - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Union Urban Affairs Ministry** has ordered the **Delhi Gymkhana Club**, located adjacent to the Prime Minister's residence, to vacate its premises by June 5th. The club's 27.3-acre plot is needed for "strengthening and securing defense infrastructure" and other vital public security purposes.  The order was issued by the Land & Development Office (L&DO) under the Union Housing and Urban Affairs Ministry, citing urgent institutional needs and governance infrastructure projects as reasons. The club has operated from the location since 1913.

top_stories.title: India is important to the U.S.’s Indo-Pacific policy, says Rubio, invites Modi to Washington - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Secretary of State Marco Rubio** began a four-day trip to India, meeting with **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and other officials.  Rubio emphasized the importance of the Indo-Pacific region and renewed the Quad engagement, highlighting India's role in U.S. policy. The visit included bilateral talks with **External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar**, attendance at the Quad Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, and a reception hosted by the U.S. Ambassador to India.  The trip also included cultural exchanges and visits to Jaipur and Agra.

top_stories.title: Future City will serve as compass for the country: TPCC chief - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Mahesh Goud**, president of the **Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC)**, criticized **T. Harish Rao**, a BRS MLA, for his comments on the future development of **Hyderabad**.  Goud argued that expanding the city's geographical limits was necessary for state development and questioned **Harish Rao**’s lack of foresight. He also stated that the Congress government is continuing previous schemes and working towards announcing names for working presidents soon.

top_stories.title: Pinarayi flays crackdown on Cockroach Janta Party - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Pinarayi Vijayan**, leader of the Opposition, criticized the **Union government's** withholding of the **Cockroach Janta Party’s X handle**. He argued that this action reflects intolerance towards democratic protests and suggests fear of the youth movement becoming a political force.  Vijayan stated that the platform has gained significant traction due to its focus on addressing unemployment and inequality, highlighting the deep discontent among young people.

top_stories.title: Naidu to inaugurate MSME Growth Summit-2026 in Vijayawada on May 25 - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** will inaugurate the **MSME Growth Summit-2026** in Vijayawada on Monday, May 25th. The event, a flagship initiative of the **Andhra Pradesh government**, aims to accelerate the growth and competitiveness of micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) across the state.  The summit will feature over 1,500 stakeholders, including entrepreneurs, industry associations, policymakers, financial institutions, and technology partners. It will showcase innovation ecosystems, infrastructure initiatives, digital transformation programs, and success stories of MSMEs from Andhra Pradesh. The summit will also launch key initiatives like the foundation stone laying for Phase III of MSME Parks, the AP Cluster Development Programme, and the SIDBI-RTIH Seed Fund.

top_stories.title: Congress slams Centre over rising fuel prices, questions PM for not disclosing seriousness of crisis - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Congress** leaders criticized the **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** government for its handling of rising fuel prices, accusing it of "looting" consumers with high taxes and failing to pass on benefits during periods of low global crude prices.  **Congress** president Mallikarjun Kharge accused the government of timing fuel price reductions around elections and resuming hikes after polling concluded. **Rajeev Gowda**, a Congress research department chairman, argued that rising fuel prices and the depreciating rupee reflected broader economic distress and called for greater transparency from the government regarding its energy policies.

top_stories.title: States to get VB-G RAM G funding based on 16th Finance Commission formula, ‘performance criteria’ - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Centre**'s new rural jobs scheme, Viksit Bharat–Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (VB-G RAM G), will prioritize funding for poorer states using the 16th Finance Commission's horizontal devolution formula. The draft rules also propose allocating a portion of funds based on performance criteria such as timely wage payments and work completion rates.  The scheme, replacing the MGNREGA Act, will have a 60:40 funding split between the Centre and states and includes provisions for grievance redressal mechanisms and administrative frameworks.  Stakeholders have until June 21st to submit their feedback on the draft rules.

top_stories.title: U.P. Congress chief Ajay Rai booked over ‘objectionable’ comment on PM Modi - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Ajay Rai**, **Uttar Pradesh Congress president**, is facing an FIR after a complaint from **Neeraj Kumar Rawat**, a BJP district working committee member, alleging abusive remarks against **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.  The complaint claims that Mr. Rai obstructed government work and blocked a public road with his convoy of vehicles and supporters. The police registered the case based on a video circulating online showing Mr. Rai making objectionable statements. Mr. Rai denies the allegations, calling it a tactic to silence him and accusing the BJP government of using state apparatus against opponents.
